predicates.label: Kind
predicates.description: quantity (a whole number in the tracker's unit), yesno or scale (1 to 5)

predicates.label: Unit
predicates.description: The whole unit a quantity tracker's values are stored in (minute, glass, ml...), as the owner chose it

predicates.label: Target
predicates.description: at_least, at_most or yes: what makes a day count as done

predicates.label: Target value
predicates.description: The threshold of at_least or at_most, in the tracker's unit

predicates.label: How often
predicates.description: day (every day), week (N done days per Monday-Sunday week) or days (at most N days between done days)

predicates.label: N
predicates.description: Done days per week, or most days between done days

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or retired (a retired tracker keeps its history)

predicates.label: Since
predicates.description: Day the tracker started, at noon local time

predicates.label: Until
predicates.description: Day the tracker was retired, at noon local time

predicates.label: Why
predicates.description: Why the owner tracks it, in their words

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order in which the tracker was created, for the grid

predicates.label: Value
predicates.description: A day's value in the tracker's unit (tracker_unit); yes/no as 1/0; scale 1-5

predicates.label: Written later
predicates.description: Days between the recorded day and the day it was written; 0 = written on the day

predicates.label: Tracker
predicates.description: The tracker a record is about

predicates.label: Month
predicates.description: The month a reflection is about, YYYY-MM

predicates.label: What went well
predicates.description: The owner's words

predicates.label: What didn't
predicates.description: The owner's words

predicates.label: Intention
predicates.description: The owner's intention for the next month, in their words

predicates.label: Symbol
predicates.description: The signifier shown before a note of this type (–, ○, !, *, •...)

predicates.label: What it is for
predicates.description: What notes of this type are, so the agent can recognize them

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or retired

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order of the type in lists

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: The note, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Type
predicates.description: The type of a note

predicates.label: Statuses
predicates.description: The collection's statuses in order, separated by |

predicates.label: Finished status
predicates.description: The status that means an item is finished

predicates.label: Rates items
predicates.description: 1 if the collection's items take a 1-5 rating, 0 if not

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or retired

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order in which the collection was created

predicates.label: What it is for
predicates.description: What the collection is for, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Collection
predicates.description: The collection an item belongs to

predicates.label: Status
predicates.description: One of its collection's statuses

predicates.label: Rating
predicates.description: 1 to 5

predicates.label: Finished on
predicates.description: Day the item reached the finished status, at noon local time

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: A short note about the item, in the owner's words

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or removed (a removed item stops showing and stays in the file)

predicates.label: Added on
predicates.description: Day the item was added, at noon local time

predicates.label: Moments of the month
predicates.description: The moments the owner chose in the reflection, one per line

note_types.name: Note
note_types.purpose: Something that happened or a thought; the default when no other type fits

note_types.name: Event
note_types.purpose: An event: something that took place at a moment, out of the routine (a wedding, a trip, a visit)

note_types.name: Task
note_types.purpose: Something to do; only when the todo howware is not in this memory
